description: Please push the local repository changes to the remote and create the pull request

request.canonical_english: Please push the local repository changes to the remote and create the pull request

acceptance_criteria: All current local changes (untracked/modified files) are committed and pushed to remote origin
A pull request is created on GitHub and its URL is returned
No secrets, tokens or credentials are committed (verified via git diff and .gitignore)
Remote branch reflects the pushed commit(s)
